2023-05-18: Evan family Rockies hike/new Prius; old car repair/sell. Friend taught watercolor; cactus painting, stress relief. Sam’s best hike: dad, age 10; wants painting, paint-set photo.
2023-05-24: Evan Jasper cabin 2023-05-20–21, Icefields Parkway; lake/book-holder photo. Sam weight flagged at checkup.
2023-06-06: Evan palpitations, cuts sugar/processed food; loves ginger snaps. Sam seltzer/dark chocolate.
2023-07-27: Sam weight-mocked 2023-07-21; gym planned 2023-07-28. Evan reads Gatsby.
2023-08-07–15: Evan Canadian SO, hiking/biking, bonsai; kids motivate health. Son ankle hurt soccer 2023-08-12, cast. Sam flying dream 2023-08-12; cooking class, salmon/veg 2023-08-14.
2023-08-19: Sam dieting, more energy; salad photo; shares chicken/veg stir-fry, homemade sauce recipe. Evan watercolor classes for peers/improvement; friend’s gift inspired start. Loves landscapes; ocean sunset painting. Banff skiing 2023-07, return 2024; enjoys snowboard/skating. Sam wants skiing, fears body can't cope.
2023-08-27: Sam started new diet/exercise 2023-08-21, huge difference, feels great. Evan twisted knee 2023-08-25; very painful, frustrates fitness consistency (activity very important). Plans PT, hopes appointment soon; swimming/keeping low-key meanwhile. Sam suggested low-impact exercise/PT, encouraged swimming. Evan engrossed in previously discussed book. Tidying found photo from 2023-07 Rockies road trip: car parked beside lake, mountains behind; scenery/nature relaxing and refreshing. Sam loves tranquil nature, no road trip in ages; hiking challenging, hopes health improvements enable trips/hikes. Evan suggests hiking together sometime; shared two lake/mountain photos, recommended unnamed lake with many nearby trails, two-hour drive, peaceful/incredible views. Sam says doable day trip, intends to visit/explore local trails.
mem.17:
2023-05-18: Evan family Rockies trip/new Prius; passionate watercolor painter. Sam wants inspiring hobby, eager to experiment; photo holding paints in store; favorite hike with dad at age 10.
2023-05-24: Jasper/Icefields; Evan’s “glacier” photo actually person/book/lake. Painting for years brings peace/creativity; advises exercise too, not painting as weight cure.
2023-06-06: Evan palpitations/meds (bottle photo), cutting sugar/processed foods; ginger snaps. Sam intends healthier eating, veg/milk photo (“salad”), but no diet changes, soda/candy.
2023-08–10: Evan son ankle cast, own knee injury/cast/PT. Sam journals/draws; Tahoe kayaking 2023-10-14; gastritis ER 2023-10-14–15; family pressure. Joint hike undated.
2023-11-09: Sam proud new Weight Watchers group coach, hopes motivate self/others. Evan lost job 2023-10, downsizing; hopeful job hunt. Friend gifted 1968 Kustom K-200A guitar (floor/strap photo). Beach/surfer sunset photo taken 2023-11-03: favorite peaceful spot near home, soothing waves. Plan visit together 2023-12.
2023-11-21: Evan hospitalized previous week after suspicious check-up finding; frightening but misunderstanding, doctors say fine, doing well now. Scare taught value of life/enjoying present. Sam discomfort limits movement, struggling with diet changes/fitness goals. Evan encourages small steps/persistence. Sam got go-to “feel good” flick 2023-11-20; accompanying photo actually book with man pictured, no title given. Agree to appreciate something/little things daily; reaffirm mutual support. Evan says fitness routine gym and taking car for a spin. Shares group around fire pit (“wild!”). Island with lone boat photo: island where Evan grew up, his happy place, shaped him, special in heart; unnamed. Also shares sun through clouds over water, person walking beach at sunset, sunset over water; describes place as serene, calming, peaceful paradise.
mem.25:
2023-06-06: Sam upset all supermarket self-checkouts broken. Evan: exercise clears mind/shared goals; photo bearded man/dumbbell.
2023-07-21: Friends mocked Sam’s weight; prompted changes, cut soda/candy.
2023-07-27: Sam healthier/more active; progress not perfection. Evan overcame health struggles; diet/lifestyle+exercise; less sugar, more produce. Suggested popcorn/fruit with seltzer. Reading “The Great Gatsby”; Sam plans read. Photos: “let it shine” cards (gym commitment), produce, fruit/alcohol, book/apple, backpacker.
2023-10: Sam gastritis ER; Evan lost job. 2023-12: Sam WW coach; Evan partner pregnant, married Canadian ~12-19.
2024-01-10: Evan apologized for 01-09 drunken rose-bush urination. Yoga helps him; Sam plans yoga/beach walks.
2024-01-11: Sam health/weight limiting life; no liked exercise; country drives relax, plans nature time. Photo field/fence/dirt road from prior week. Evan’s partner unhappy but understanding; promised care. Photos: kayak/sunset camping summer 2023; pink-flowered park tree cheered him spring 2023.
